Poster: `posters/<slug>/`

- [ ] `poster.yml` matches the poster
- [ ] `poster.pdf` is the version that was presented
- [ ] `abstract.pdf`, if included, is the extended abstract of this poster
- [ ] `poster-source/` and `abstract-source/`, if included, are the sources of these PDFs
- [ ] All authors agree to publishing it
